governance: Read-only Git discovery precedes write-capable integration.
Imported archive code is never executed during intake.
Hashes establish identity and integrity, not semantic truth.
AI-generated output and council consensus are not proof.
Numerical simulation, benchmark, formal proof, physical measurement and engineering qualification remain distinct.
Every worker is capability-scoped, leased, idempotent, bounded and observable.
Promotion requires independent qualification, rollback and no authority expansion.
Cache keys bind source, dependency, model, parameters, seed, toolchain and environment; cache hits are not fresh verification.
Engineering CAD/wiring outputs remain proposals until native validation, source data and independent sign-off.

limitations: This catalog reconciles available project summaries, handoffs, selected Library sources, current branch files and open PR metadata; it does not claim exhaustive retrieval of every historical raw chat.
Foundation v0.2's reported 1,452 artifacts are not individually enumerated in the current repo artifact index.
Part 1 and Part 2 of the five-archive intake need their original bytes, hashes and inventories before intake can be marked complete.
The current repository artifact index is a changed-file list for PRs #72–#74, not a full recursive repository manifest.
Archive-only and context-only projects are not represented as implemented runtime capabilities.

catalog_maintenance.rule: Every new Merlin project conversation, decision, research idea, module, artifact, integration or result must be assigned a stable catalog ID and recorded with provenance.
catalog_maintenance.status_rule: Keep archive-only, context-only, planned, specification-only, prototype, partial, implemented, tested and independently verified states distinct.
catalog_maintenance.append_only: Do not silently overwrite prior decisions. Add a superseding record and link the earlier record.
catalog_maintenance.artifact_rule: Record exact repository path, source commit, content hash and test/evidence reference when available.
catalog_maintenance.authority_rule: Cataloging does not confer implementation, proof, safety or deployment approval.
